Bug_Details: Detects classes which implement Parcelable but don't have CREATOR
Bug_Explanation: The bug is that a class implementing Parcelable does not have a CREATOR field, which is required for proper object serialization and deserialization. This will lead to a runtime exception when trying to write the Parcelable object to a Parcel.
